n: Cornell K-12 Bird Bingo and Merlin activities
t: A free bird bingo activity with an optional Merlin app to find local birds.
steps: Find the Bird Bingo activity in the Cornell Lab K-12 free downloads.
Print the bingo cards or plan to draw them.
Install the Merlin Bird ID app on one teacher device if you want local suggestions.
Use the Explore feature to list birds likely near school.
Fill a 3 by 3 card with those birds.
Take students outside or to a window to mark the birds they see.
